entries.label: hires2x_pack_not_found
entries.body:
Hmm...
You were trying to run the game in hi-res
640x480 mode, but the game couldn't find
the 'hires2x' addon .uqm package.

Are you sure you have downloaded it and
installed it into the correct folder?

Solutions:
-Either install the 'hires2x' package and play,
-or select the 320x240 resolution and play.
